summary: A user reported Telegram groups promoting arbitrage opportunities that direct victims to deposit tokens on newly registered exchanges such as Qolbit and related sites. The platforms allow initial trades then lock accounts and demand VIP fees to release funds indicating a fake exchange arbitrage scam.
user_mistake: Deposited tokens to an unverified exchange promoted in a Telegram arbitrage group
prevention: Avoid exchanges promoted in messaging app arbitrage signals / Verify exchange regulatory registration and domain history before depositing assets
